units.source_text: 大部分的故事，似乎都把重點放在了丈夫是否原諒妻子的「行為」上，

en.t: Most stories seem to focus on whether the husband forgives the wife's conduct,

units.source_text: 但對我來說，並不覺得是什麼痛苦的大問題。

en.t: But to me, it did not feel like some terribly painful major problem.

units.source_text: 原諒，不原諒，保留這種權利的丈夫才是幸運，

en.t: The husband who can reserve the right to forgive or not forgive is the fortunate one,

units.source_text: 倘若認為妻子無法原諒，也沒必要大吵大鬧，

en.t: If he thinks he cannot forgive his wife, there is no need to make a great fuss,

units.source_text: 趕快離婚再娶一位就行了。

en.t: he can simply divorce her quickly and marry someone else.

units.source_text: 如果做不到，那隻好「原諒」妻子，嚥下這口氣。

en.t: If he cannot do that, then he has no choice but to 'forgive' his wife and swallow his anger.

units.source_text: 總之，只要丈夫橫下心，就能平息方方面面的事態。

en.t: In short, as long as the husband hardens his heart, he can settle matters on every side.
